slides.title: The basics
head: Term
In one line
rows: Token
A chunk of text a model reads: a word, part of one, or punctuation
Prompt
The instructions and text you give a model
Training
Adjusting a model using data so it gets better at a task
Inference
Using a trained model to produce an answer

slides.title: How models are used
head: Term
In one line
rows: Context window
How much text a model can consider at once
Fine-tuning
Training a model further on extra data
RAG
Looking up documents first, then answering from them
Embedding
Text turned into numbers so similar meanings sit close together

slides.title: What to watch for
head: Term
In one line
rows: Hallucination
A confident answer that is false or unsupported
Agent
A model that uses tools over several steps to reach a goal
Multimodal
Handles more than one kind of input, such as text and images
Parameter
A value a model learns during training
